name: Prompt Compression Engine (LLMLingua2)
description: Compresses prompts by pruning low-information tokens using LLMLingua2 (Microsoft OSS), reducing token usage by 30-70% while preserving key semantic instructions.

fields.name: rate
fields.label: Target Compression Rate
fields.helperText: Fraction of original tokens to preserve (e.g. 0.5 = 50% target token rate).

fields.name: force_reserve_keywords
fields.label: Force Reserve Key Words
fields.helperText: Comma-separated list of instruction words that must never be pruned.
